title: Hosting Setup for Deployment
content: Setup hosting environment to receive and deploy code from git repository.

items.title: Prepare hosting environment
items.what: Install required software (git, PHP, Node, etc.)
items.how: On hosting: apt-get install git php8.2-cli nodejs (Ubuntu) OR yum install git php nodejs (CentOS)

items.title: Setup git credentials
items.why: Allow hosting to pull from repository
items.what: Configure SSH key or access token
items.how: ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C 'hosting@server.com' → Add public key to GitHub/GitLab deploy keys

items.title: Clone repository
items.how: cd /var/www/platform/code && git clone git@github.com:user/platform.git . — Clone to current directory

items.title: Checkout target branch
items.why: Deploy from correct branch (staging or production)
items.how: git checkout staging — Or git checkout main for production

items.title: Setup auto-pull mechanism (webhook)
items.what: Create webhook endpoint to receive push notifications
items.how: Create webhook.php that runs: git pull origin <branch> when triggered; configure webhook URL in GitHub/GitLab settings

items.title: Setup auto-pull mechanism (cron job)
items.what: Cron job to pull changes every N minutes
items.how: crontab -e → Add: '*/5 * * * * cd /var/www/platform/code && git pull origin staging >> /var/www/platform/logs/git-pull.log 2>&1' — Pulls every 5 minutes

items.title: Setup deployment logging
items.what: Log git pull results and timestamps
items.how: Redirect output to logs/git-pull.log (shown in HS-07); rotate logs with logrotate

items.title: Configure file permissions
items.why: Ensure web server can read files
items.how: chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/platform/code && chmod -R 755 /var/www/platform/code — Adjust user/group as needed

items.title: Setup web server (Apache/Nginx)
items.what: Configure virtual host to point to application

items.title: Setup environment variables
items.how: Create .env in /var/www/platform/code/ with: DB_HOST, DB_USER, API_KEYS, etc. — Ensure .env is in .gitignore

items.title: Test manual pull
items.how: cd /var/www/platform/code && git pull origin staging — Should download latest code without errors

items.title: Test webhook/cron
items.how: Push dummy commit to repo → Check logs/git-pull.log for pull activity within 5 minutes

items.title: Document hosting config
items.what: Record server details, credentials locations, cron jobs
items.how: Create hosting-config.md with: server IP, SSH access, git remote, cron schedule, log locations
